outcome.Summary: Implemented `TopK` in words/words.go: a rune-level state machine over a buffered reader (bufio.Reader + one-rune lookahead) that tokenizes maximal runs of Unicode letters/digits, keeping apostrophes only when internal to a word (don't, o'clock), case-folds with strings.ToLower, drops stop words (case-insensitive map), and returns the top k by count desc / word asc (byte order); k<=0 returns an empty non-nil slice and read errors from r are propagated. Verified with words/words_test.go covering counts, folding, stopwords, apostrophe edge cases, separators, tie-breaking, unicode, long lines, error propagation, and a 300MB streaming perf check (~6s, bounded memory); `go test ./... -count=1` and `go vet ./...` both pass.
